messages:
elaine.m: Quick sync — Acme escalated an SLA ask (99.9%) and is pushing for embeddings in v1. We need to decide whether to reserve a release slot + infra commit or split embeddings to a v1.1 hotfix. Opinions?

marcos: Need numbers. What does embedding infra change for commit and latency?

priya: Customer signal is strong — pilot search relies on embeddings. But we also promised a launch date. :thinking_face:

omar: From infra ops: reserving dedicated capacity for embeddings bumps committed spend ~+20% monthly. If we split, we avoid the commit but add routing+fallback complexity.

jess: Design: we can ship a reasonable fallback UX without embeddings (lexical ranking + suggested queries). It'll be noticeably worse but usable for general users. For pilot customers we can enable a better experience behind a flag.

marcos: Quick perf/cost sketch:
```
Option A (embeddings in v1): commit +20% vs baseline, p95 gen +80ms
Option B (split to v1.1): commit +5%, p95 gen +120ms for fallback, +2 developer sprints for routing/fallback logic
```

elaine.m: OK. If we split, we must define rollout criteria and canary plan. Proposal:
- Ship core v1 without embeddings by target date
- Canary embeddings to 10% of traffic on dedicated infra for pilot customers
- Guardrails: p95 < 100ms, error rate < 0.2%, embedding QPS < reserved cap

priya: Acme timeline: they need embeddings available by early June. Can we do a targeted hotfix/canary in May for them?

omar: deploy-bot: Canary infra ticket created — ops#1234. Provision window estimated 2 weeks.

marcos: Dev estimate: embedding infra + KV cache work ~6w, routing + flags ~2w. If we fold into v1 we push launch by ~3w. If we split, we keep launch date but add rollout work post-launch.

elaine.m: My recommendation: freeze v1 scope to core features (no embeddings), commit to a v1.1 hotfix for pilot customers (Acme) with dedicated canary in May and broad rollout in June. @marcos @omar please confirm sign-off so I can tell Acme and update the roadmap.

marcos: :thumbsup: I sign off on the split. Will scope the 6w work into a separate sprint track and deliver the canary plan.

omar: Signed off. Need ops runbook + oncall rotations documented (ops#1234). I'll own the runbook.

jess: Acknowledged — will prepare fallback copy and a minimal UX polish for the v1 experience.

priya: I'll negotiate timeline with Acme and push for the May canary. Will also confirm SLA wording to match canary limits.

elaine.m: Great — I'll update the release tracker and set a follow-up sync next Tue to finalize canary checklist. Thanks everyone!
